items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice again Thursday after missing prior sessions; DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited.
items.why: Continued hamstring absence; Smith limited (hamstring/toe) after prior DNPs.
items.implication: Barkley Week 6 availability doubtful/risky; thin Eagles RB room (Shipley also out, Bigsby IR) elevates handcuffs.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/ dual-threat snaps to remaining backs if Barkley OUT; Smith limited upgrade positive for WR role.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) and WR Tank Dell (knee) will not travel to London and ruled OUT vs Jaguars; S Jalen Pitre also OUT.
items.why: Groin injury prevents travel; Dell knee similarly sidelined.
items.implication: Full RB snaps to handcuff (Woody Marks per Berry: 98% prior, every touch); Dell absence opens WR targets.
items.opportunity: Marks/committee full workload, red-zone/ dual role expansion vs JAX.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled OUT for Week 6 (and indefinitely per Rapoport) after follow-up ultrasound showed movement in superficial blood clot in calf; Tanner McKee to start. Full team statement details cleat injury history, prior clearance to play in London, and priority on treatment/health.
items.why: Clot movement detected Wednesday night ultrasound; treatment course TBD (possible blood thinners preclude play).
items.implication: McKee starts vs CAR; Eagles offense downgrade, Hurts managers scramble for streamers/ROS uncertainty.
items.opportunity: Backup QB volume and any short-yardage/goal-line shifts if McKee less mobile.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return (shoulder) mid-game Thursday night vs SEA, then returned to the game.
items.why: Shoulder injury mid-game; cleared to return.
items.implication: Played through; monitor residual effects but active for remainder.
items.opportunity: No major role change; continued usage if healthy.
items.conflict: Berry hates Waddle this week on matchup/volume.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore did not practice for second straight day due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Availability risk vs LV; target share to other Bills WRs if limited.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love did not practice second straight day (ankle).
items.implication: Week 6 questionable/out risk; ARI RB committee shifts.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for other Cardinals RBs.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice did not practice again Thursday due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Questionable/game-time or OUT risk; KC WR targets redistribute (Worthy etc.).
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for other Chiefs WRs if limited/out.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson officially did not practice again Thursday (ankle).
items.implication: Week 6 status uncertain; monitor Friday/Saturday for active.
items.opportunity: If out, backup QB and adjusted run/pass shares.

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy, Ertz etc.); Saquon turns 30 in Feb—if Super Bowl contender with RB need, at least call. Worth risk of year-too-early vs too-late.
items.why: Age + Eagles precedent + current hamstring; move early.
items.implication: Fantasy managers consider selling Saquon now while value holds amid injury/age concerns.
items.opportunity: Trade market opportunity; handcuff priority if holding.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @ GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ) for volume vs leaky run defenses; Kyren elite recent usage, Javonte goal-line role, Stevenson post-Henderson multi-week high-ankle (85% snaps/23 touches prior).
items.why: Volume + matchups; Henderson multi-week OUT boosts Stevenson to 16.3 PPG historical >15 touches.
items.implication: RB2/flex starts with upside; Stevenson clear lead back.
items.opportunity: Carries, snaps, goal-line for all three; Stevenson full role.

items.text: Bhayshul Tuten snap/Utilization rising every week (77 score Week 5, 11th); post-Montgomery, Woody Marks 98% snaps/every RB touch (better metrics). Tuten viable, Marks low-end RB2 while Monty out.
items.why: Progressive snap/target share for Tuten; full takeover for Marks on Monty OUT.
items.implication: Waiver/flex priority Tuten; start Marks in deeper leagues.
items.opportunity: Rising routes/touches Tuten; full RB workload Marks.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day, on track to start vs Falcons.
items.implication: Expected starter; positive for Bears pass catchers.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders defense buffet for pass catchers, Evans season-high 36% target share Week 5, even higher when Deebo off field (now multi-week out).
items.why: Elite matchup + elevated target share post-Deebo injury; soft secondary.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; high upside Week 6.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets/red-zone with thin SF WR depth behind.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (WR34 vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (TE18 vs CHI) due to tough matchups and shaky QB/usage; Waddle 67% yards in one game, averages 16.5 otherwise.
items.conflict: Waddle returned from mid-game Q but volume still low historically.
